text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival. To show
their gratitude to the fans who cheer them on,
the Umamusume challenge themselves in various competitions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a festival to enjoy with lots of friends.
There was no way Tap Dance City
wouldn't get fired up...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――It's show time!
Everyone, it's finally our turn!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"‘100-Person 101-Legged Race’!
Let's show them the bond between teammates!"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then everyone, let me hear your ideas!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few months before the Fan Appreciation Festival...
Tap Dance City was having a meeting with her friends
about how to make the event as fun as possible.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"And there's the total dump of responsibility~.
Thought so."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Asking someone who knows the ropes is one of the best ways to have a blast, right?!
choice_data_list: Didn't they have sports days or anything over there?
Didn't they have sports days or anything over there?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There were similar things, but...
Practicing together and competing seriously...
I never had anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm looking forward to it!
I mean—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Solidarity." Wonderful, isn't it?
Nothing beats becoming one with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tell me a sport you'd recommend
that gets you fired up with your friends!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I wonder... A three-legged race
is a classic, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
A three-legged race, that's that thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Like this, putting our arms over each other's shoulders... Alright, let's step forward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Faceplant!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...So basically,
it's one of those things where pairs run together, right!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true, but...
Trainer took a pretty hard fall, didn't they?
choice_data_list: Tap sure has a huge stride...

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"It's hard to stay in sync like that, you know.
Though we practice closely enough to build a real sense of unity."

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I saw this TV show way back~, where a massive crowd
did a giant three-legged race... or something like that.
That was so amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
！！
I'm totally stealing that!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"A 100-person, 101-legged race!
Let's do this!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text: A 101-legged race?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the sudden challenge initiated by Tap Dance City
and her companions for the 100-person 101-legged race—

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa there, watch out!
Right lane is moving way too slow!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're going way too fast!
Could you have some consideration for a human!?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, don't leave the middle behind!
We're getting split apart~! Stop~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it sounded interesting, but...
Is this really going to work?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Progress was rough. The differences between Umamusume and humans,
abilities, training volume, motivation...
Having 100 people run with one heart proved exceedingly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hmm! I thought it'd be a breeze once we got our friends together.
choice_data_list: First, we need to get on the same page.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ho? That's rare,
for you to bring feelings into this.
choice_data_list: I think mentality is the most important thing in this sport.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, unless everyone completely trusts one another,
we won't even be able to take a single step forward.
The fear of a collapse is far beyond your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They should already share mutual trust as teammates.
Once we stabilize things on the mental side, I want to make fine adjustments so they can run all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I see. In other words... we just gotta show 'em that our bond is what lets us run, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone!
Trainer and I are gonna run the three-legged race right now!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, are you gonna be okay? Last time, you totally knocked Trainer-san flat on their face.
You don't want that again, do you, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That was pretty sudden back then!
This time, I'll match your pace, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Trainer?
You believe in me, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—Here we go!
—One! Two! One! Two!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matching Tap Dance City's cue,
I take a step forward. Believing in her,
I cast away my fear and run at full speed...!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
...!
Incredible, it's a perfect fit...!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh...!
They crossed the finish line in perfect sync!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's because my Trainer believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trust the person next to you, the comrades locking shoulders with you!
We're one team, aren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Let's show them the bond of Team Tap Dance City
with a 100-person 101-legged race!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, with Tap Dance City firing up everyone's motivation, practice continued as a united team until... the day arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, today is a festival!
Don't overthink it, let's just have fun!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Everything we've built up will take care of the rest on its own. ...Probably!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
What do you mean, "maybe"?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nice.
Looks like everyone's loosened up now.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I leave my flank to you. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ――One! Two! One! Two!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the 100-person, 101-legged race.
Breathing as one, dashing forward with bonds of trust...!
The result was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Aaah!
That was so close at the end!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Tap!
If this side hadn't collapsed, we could've made it to the end!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Because I truly felt it.
The moment our hearts became one.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Well, for now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Let's all lie down together and look at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The weather was so nice, after all!
Man, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Although the result was disappointing, the teammates who gave it their all... were all smiling.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――I did it...!
Awesooooome!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's a massive success!!
You guys are the absolute best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City and the 98 members embracing each other in celebration. Looking at that scene—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Must be nice, having Tap Dance City around.
It'd be so fun to hang out with her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Heeeee~~y! I've taken a liking to you!
Let me join your crew too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're welcome!
We always welcome new friends!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Tap!
Toss your Trainer in the air!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oho?
Oh~, you mean that thing you throw into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OK! After all, Trainer is the unsung hero!
Hey everyone, give us a hand!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! 
You believe in me, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, HIYAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 100-person 101-legged race was a success...
Having made more friends, it truly became an unforgettable memory.
